items.title: Hypothetical Example of Space Time (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Hypothetical Example of Space Time: a main subheading of 11.5 Space-time in relativity, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 256-258.

blocks.text: Ek spaceship light ki aadhi speed se ek sitare ki taraf ja raha hai. Zameen wale observer ke hisab se sitare tak pohanchne mein aath saal lagte hain. Zameen ke nazariye se spaceship ki ghariyan ahista chal rahi hain, is liye spaceship par Zameen ke muqable mein kam waqt guzarta hai.

Spaceship walon ke liye safar ki length hi chhoti ho gayi hai (length contraction), jise woh kam waqt mein tay karte hain. Spaceship wale manzil tak pohanchne mein 8 ke bajaye 7 saal record karte hain (8 × √(1 − 0.25) = 8 × 0.866 ≈ 6.9, yani taqreeban 7).

blocks.prompt: Space-time ke baare mein Einstein ka khayal bayan karein aur batayein ke is ke mutabiq gravity kya hai. Kuch misalein dein jahan relativity ke results sach sabit hue.
blocks.explanation: Space aur time mil kar chaar dimensions wala space-time banate hain, jise mass mor deta hai, jaise bhari gend lachakdar chadar mein garha banati hai. Gravity force nahi balke mure hue space-time mein objects aur light ka geodesics par chalna hai; yeh inverse square law ki wajah batata hai aur sitaron ki light ke murne (1919) aur gravitational waves (2015) ki prediction (peshgoi) karta hai. Special relativity ki confirmation (tasdeeq): tez chalte unstable particles time dilation ki wajah se zyada der zinda rehte hain, accelerators mein particles ka mass aur energy barhte hain, aur nuclear reactions mein nikalne wali energy E = mc² ke mutabiq hai.

items: Space: teen dimensions; time: chautha dimension, relativity mein absolute nahi. Space-time dono ko jorta hai; mass ise morta hai (chadar par bhari gend, Fig. 11.2); objects aur light gravity ki force ke bajaye geodesics par chalte hain.
Einstein Newton ke inverse square law ki wajah batata hai: Suraj se sitaron ki light ka murna (1.745 seconds of arc, 1919); gravitational waves 2015 mein detect hui.
Examples: 0.95 c par 3.0 s ka period 9.6 s; 0.75 c par 1.0 m ki chhar 0.66 m; 0.8 c par m = 1.67 mₒ. c/2 par spaceship: Zameen par 8 saal, jahaz par taqreeban 7 saal.
